title: Prayer Makes a Difference in Our Destiny
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful testimony of his own life and death encounter with God, revealing the ways in which we can avoid the devil's attempts to take us out and live a life that honors God. You'll be inspired by Pastor Chris's vulnerability and encouraged to pray for yourself and your loved ones, covering them with the blood of Jesus. Don't miss this unforgettable sermon about the supernatural power of prayer and the unrelenting love of our Savior.
